# M4 — Implementation and ablations

**Status:** complete (1 November 2026). Plan: [`plan.md`](plan.md). Ablation
plan, written before any ablation was computed: [`ablation_plan.md`](ablation_plan.md).

## What ran

- **One intervention:** Patient-ID–stratified re-aggregation of the frozen M2
  out-of-fold (OOF) predictions. This is an evaluation/reporting change, not a
  model improvement. No retraining, threshold change, new data, augmentation
  or model change. "Patient-ID" is the official NLM mapping key in
  `patient_id`; it is not a slide ID or a patient diagnosis.
- **Inputs (read-only):** `results/baseline/per_sample_predictions.csv`,
  `fold_assignments.csv`, `fold_results.csv`, `baseline_results.csv`. Their
  SHA-256 hashes are recorded in `results/m4/primary_verdict.json` and checked
  again at the end of the run.
- **Reuse assertions (all PASS):** 27,558 rows; unique `relative_path`;
  folds, labels and Patient-IDs identical to `fold_assignments.csv`; each of
  the 201 Patient-IDs in exactly one fold; saved predictions equal
  `p >= 0.5`; pooled per-fold metrics recomputed with
  `src.evaluation.binary_metrics` equal `fold_results.csv` (largest absolute
  difference 1.1e-16, tolerance 1e-9); fold mean/SD equal
  `baseline_results.csv`. The pooled M2 numbers are unchanged.
- **Code:** `src/patient_stratified.py` (pure functions), `src/run_m4.py`
  (I/O), `src/plots.py`; tests in `tests/`. Command:
  `.venv/bin/python -m src.run_m4`. Notebook:
  `notebooks/m4_patient_stratified.ipynb` (runs top to bottom).

Of the 201 Patient-IDs, 151 have at least one Parasitized
cell and 50 have only Uninfected cells. Sensitivity is
undefined for those 50 and they are counted, not dropped
(per fold: 10 / 10 / 10 / 9 / 11). Every ID has Uninfected cells, so
specificity is defined for all of them.

## Verdict: INCONCLUSIVE

Pre-registered rule (`../m3/hypothesis.md`, recorded 3 October 2026):
SUPPORTED if at least 4 of 5 paired differences (macro − pooled sensitivity)
are negative **and** their mean is ≤ −1.68 pp. UNSUPPORTED is the mirror
rule. Anything else is INCONCLUSIVE.

| | Predicted (M3) | Observed (M4) |
|---|---|---|
| Direction | negative | 4 of 5 folds negative (fold 2 positive) |
| Mean macro − pooled | about −3.00 pp to −1.00 pp | −1.56 pp (inside the predicted range) |
| Decision threshold | mean ≤ −1.68 pp | not met: 1.56 pp < 1.68 pp (short by 0.12 pp) |

The direction was right in 4 of 5 folds, and the mean landed inside the
predicted range. But the magnitude did not reach the pre-registered
threshold, so the outcome is **INCONCLUSIVE**. Applying the threshold's exact
source value (half of the M2 sensitivity fold SD, 1.679 pp)
gives the same verdict (INCONCLUSIVE).

| Fold | IDs | Pooled (%) | Macro (%) | Δ (pp) | 95% CI (pp) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 30 | 95.31 | 91.15 | −4.16 | [−7.58, −0.93] |
| 2 | 30 | 88.28 | 89.72 | +1.45 | [−3.81, 6.68] |
| 3 | 31 | 96.38 | 95.55 | −0.83 | [−2.72, 1.48] |
| 4 | 31 | 95.52 | 93.97 | −1.55 | [−3.79, 0.58] |
| 5 | 29 | 95.71 | 92.99 | −2.72 | [−5.91, 0.08] |
| Mean | 151 | 94.24 | 92.68 | −1.56 | [−2.95, −0.04] |

Pooled values are M2's cell-weighted sensitivities, unchanged. CIs are 95%
cluster-bootstrap percentile intervals over Patient-IDs within each fold
(ablation A4; 2,000 resamples, seed 42). The cruder
across-fold *t*-interval for the mean is [−4.18, 1.05] pp. No significance test is
claimed: with five pairs, the smallest attainable two-sided exact Wilcoxon
p-value is 0.0625, and no test was pre-registered.

## Secondary metrics (pre-registered as descriptive)

- **Specificity:** macro − pooled is +0.01 pp on average (95% CI
  [−0.03, 0.05] pp; largest single fold 0.06 pp). Uninfected cells
  per Patient-ID are nearly constant (63–77, SD
  2.09), so macro and cell-weighted specificity almost coincide by
  construction.
- **Accuracy:** macro − pooled is −0.03 pp (95% CI [−0.57, 0.55] pp).
- **Heterogeneity:** per-ID sensitivity SD ranges 6.0 pp–13.4 pp
  across folds, versus 3.6 pp–9.3 pp for per-ID
  accuracy. Sensitivity is the more variable of the two in
  4 of 5 folds. Parasitized cells per Patient-ID
  range from 1 to 633 (median 33).

| Fold | IDs | No Parasitized cells | SD sens. | IQR FNR | Min-max FNR | SD accuracy |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 40 | 10 | 0.134 | 0.097 | 0.000-0.514 | 0.067 |
| 2 | 40 | 10 | 0.133 | 0.137 | 0.000-0.606 | 0.093 |
| 3 | 41 | 10 | 0.060 | 0.079 | 0.000-0.250 | 0.084 |
| 4 | 40 | 9 | 0.075 | 0.090 | 0.000-0.286 | 0.036 |
| 5 | 40 | 11 | 0.087 | 0.100 | 0.000-0.333 | 0.061 |

## Ablation summary (exploratory; they do not change the primary verdict)

| Ablation (exploratory) | Setting | IDs | Mean Δ (pp) | Folds < 0 | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Primary (M3 rule) | macro, >= 1 Parasitized cell | 151 | −1.56 | 4/5 | verdict INCONCLUSIVE |
| A1 weighting | per-ID, weighted by cells | 151 |  | - | identical to pooled in all folds (max abs. difference 0.0e+00) |
| A2 eligibility | >= 10 Parasitized cells | 121 | −2.00 | 4/5 | 98.9% of positive cells kept |
| A2 eligibility | >= 25 Parasitized cells | 84 | −1.28 | 4/5 | 94.5% of positive cells kept |
| A3 leave-one-ID-out | 151 single-ID deletions | 150 remain |  | - | mean range −2.00 to −1.27; 2 change the verdict |
| A4 cluster bootstrap | 2,000 resamples, seed 42 | 151 | −1.56 | - | 95% CI [−2.95, −0.04] |
| A5 specificity | macro over IDs with Uninfected cells | 201 | +0.01 | 3/5 | 95% CI [−0.03, 0.05] |
| A5 accuracy | macro over all IDs | 201 | −0.03 | 3/5 | 95% CI [−0.57, 0.55] |

- **A1:** weighting each ID's sensitivity by its Parasitized-cell count
  reproduces the pooled value exactly, as it must. The whole
  macro-vs-pooled gap is the change of weighting.
- **A2:** restricting the macro to IDs with ≥ 10 Parasitized cells moves the
  mean to −2.00 pp; ≥ 25 moves it to −1.28 pp. The result
  depends on the eligibility rule in both directions, and neither variant
  replaces the pre-registered ≥ 1 rule.
- **A3:** deleting one Patient-ID at a time (151 deletions)
  keeps the mean between −2.00 pp and −1.27 pp.
  2 single deletions would change the verdict (to SUPPORTED):
  C116P77ThinF (fold 2), C182P143NThinF (fold 5). The verdict is therefore fragile, and the most influential
  ID is C116P77ThinF (fold 2: 414 Parasitized
  cells, sensitivity 72.5%).
- **A4:** the cluster-bootstrap 95% CI for the mean difference is
  [−2.95, −0.04] pp. It excludes zero but includes −1.68 pp; the per-fold CIs
  are wide.
- **A5:** specificity and accuracy barely move (above).

## Interpretation (kept short; see the paper and M5)

Cell weighting does mask hard Patient-IDs in 4 folds, as hypothesised. In
fold 2 it works the other way: several large IDs are hard
(6 of the 10 IDs with the most false negatives are in
that fold), so the pooled value sits *below* the macro. The predicted
mechanism, unequal cell counts, is visible. The direction of its effect
depends on whether the large IDs in a fold are easy or hard.
